title: Uniform finite-metric randomized k-server implementation
exact_target: For every finite rational metric and $2\leq k<n$, is there one randomized online bit algorithm with polynomial preprocessing in input length L and polynomial work per request in L+log(t+1), guaranteeing expected cost $\leq C(\log (k+1))^{2}OPT+B$ for every finite oblivious sequence, without knowing its horizon?
